verdict.rationale: Superpowers keeps no data in a proprietary store. Its skills are plain markdown folders, its working artifacts (task briefs, review packages, plans) are files written into a per-plan directory in the repo, and git history is the durable record, so leaving costs little. However, it has no documented export or offboarding capability and no stated data-portability guarantee; openness here comes from the plain-file design rather than an export feature. Missing for 10: documented export/uninstall path, explicit statement covering all data the plugin produces, independent corroboration of clean exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
